verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents a Video API for generating finished video files. Its quickstart describes polling, or configuring a webhook, until the video completes, then downloading the .mp4 via a time-limited link in the `download` attribute. This covers both job submission and asset retrieval. A live docs llms.txt probe confirms the API documentation exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration that the API workflow works as documented.
